what_changed: src/sec10k/eval_adapter.py: new `meta_field` check type — `item_field`'s counterpart for the contract's normative `meta` keys, asserting one by value.

src/sec10k/eval_adapter.py::envelope_shape: recomputes the contract's own definition of coverage (span-carrying chars / normalized chars, 4 dp) from the items the SAME envelope publishes, and refuses any envelope whose published `meta.coverage` disagrees. This is the root-cause binding for the finding's second-order point: extract.py publishes and validate.py thresholds from two calls to one function, and it is their AGREEMENT that is now pinned.
evals/adversarial/xref-index-collapse.json: `meta_field coverage 0.0303` — the low end of the published range.
src/sec10k/test_eval_adapter.py: new `test_meta_field`, plus four assertions in `test_envelope_shape` covering the agreement check and the refusal path (self-check 20/20 -> 21/21).
specs/decisions/ADR-034 §f1 corrected — its claimed compensation was false as written; it now states what actually binds each field, with a dated correction note naming PR #57 R1.
covered_by: +22 further committed cases now red under the mutant, via envelope_shape
resolutions.red_evidence: The reviewer's own mutant (`meta["coverage"] = 1.0`) applied verbatim at ec2d0a5: first reproduced the finding (invariant 69/69 = 1.000, fast 132/132 = 1.000 while every document publishes coverage 1.0), then the pins were added against the STILL-MUTATED tree and went red for the right reason — `meta.coverage 1.0 != 0.0303` and `!= 0.982`, with 24 cases red across the full suites (invariant 62/69 = 0.899, fast 108/132 = 0.818). Mutant reverted: all green.
resolutions.note: One producer was considered and NOT taken. Collapsing extract.py and validate.py onto a single computed value is a behaviour-neutral refactor whose blast radius would still have to be re-measured, and it would not fix the defect — a single producer can still publish a figure no case ever reads. Pinning the agreement is the smaller and the stronger change. Recorded in ADR-034 §f1.
